acts.8.p1.b1.text: And Saul was there, giving approval to Stephen’s death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

acts.8.p1.b2.text: God-fearing men buried Stephen and mourned deeply over him.

acts.8.p1.b3.text: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house,

acts.8.p1.b4.text: … he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.

acts.8.p2.b1.text: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went. Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ to them.

acts.8.p2.b2.text: The crowds gave their undivided attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.

acts.8.p2.b3.text: … and many of the paralyzed and lame were healed.

acts.8.p2.b4.text: So there was great joy in that city.

acts.8.p3.b1.text: Prior to that time, a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and astounded the people of Samaria. He claimed to be someone great,

acts.8.p3.b2.text: “This man is the divine power called the Great Power.”

acts.8.p3.b3.text: But when they believed Philip as he preached the gospel of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

acts.8.p3.b4.text: Even Simon himself believed and was baptized. He followed Philip closely and was astounded by the great signs and miracles he observed.

acts.8.p4.b1.text: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.

acts.8.p4.b2.text: On their arrival, they prayed for them to receive the Holy Spirit.

acts.8.p4.b3.text: Then Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

acts.8.p5.b1.text: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money.

acts.8.p5.b2.text: “Give me this power as well,” he said, “so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit.”

acts.8.p5.b4.text: because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

acts.8.p6.b1.text: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.

acts.8.p6.b2.text: “Pray to the Lord for me, so that nothing you have said may happen to me.”

acts.8.p6.b3.text: And after Peter and John had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the gospel in many of the Samaritan villages.

acts.8.p7.b1.text: “Get up and go south to the desert road that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza.”

acts.8.p7.b3.text: … and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official … He had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

acts.8.p7.b4.text: and on his return was sitting in his chariot reading Isaiah the prophet.

acts.8.p8.b1.text: “Go over to that chariot and stay by it.”

acts.8.p8.b2.text: “Do you understand what you are reading?”

acts.8.p8.b3.text: “How can I,” he said, “unless someone guides me?”

acts.8.p8.b4.text: And he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

acts.8.p9.b1.text: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture:

acts.8.p9.b2.text: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.

acts.8.p9.b3.text: In His humiliation He was deprived of justice. … For His life was removed from the earth.”

acts.8.p10.b1.text: “Tell me,” said the eunuch, “who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?”

acts.8.p10.b2.text: Then Philip began with this very Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

acts.8.p11.b1.text: “Look, here is water! What is there to prevent me from being baptized?”

acts.8.p11.b2.text: And he gave orders to stop the chariot.

acts.8.p11.b3.text: Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

acts.8.p12.b1.text: When they came up out of the water,

acts.8.p12.b2.text: the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away,

acts.8.p12.b3.text: and the eunuch saw him no more,

acts.8.p12.b4.text: but went on his way rejoicing.

acts.8.p13.b2.text: and traveled through that region, preaching the gospel in all the towns
